## Research interests

Synthetic aperture radar · complex-valued / phase-aware deep learning ·
geospatial foundation models · remote sensing for environmental and humanitarian use.

## Education

- **Ph.D., Electrical Engineering** — The University of Texas at Dallas, 2022.
  GPA 4.0/4.0. Advisor: Prof. Murat Torlak. Dissertation: *Novel Hybrid-Learning
  Algorithms for Improved Millimeter-Wave Imaging Systems*. Five first-author IEEE
  papers; one granted patent.
- **B.S., Electrical Engineering** — The University of Texas at Dallas, 2019.
  GPA 3.98/4.0, *summa cum laude*; completed in three years. 2× UTDesign Senior
  Capstone 1st place.

## Experience

### Lead AI Scientist — Privateer Space
*Jan 2025 – Present*

- Architected and shipped **Model Studio**, a multi-tenant no-code geospatial
  CV/MLOps platform — automated planetary-scale preprocessing, foundation-model
  fine-tuning, and one-click cloud/edge deployment — cutting non-experts'
  time-to-solution from months to under a week.
- Built the operational Earth-observation data layer end-to-end (Sentinel-1/2 and
  high-resolution optical) with the `rasterio` / `geopandas` / `shapely` / `xarray` /
  GDAL stack, and directed geospatial foundation-model research across optical and SAR.

### Principal Research Scientist — KBR
*Sep 2023 – Jan 2025*

- Led production SAR detection pipelines on large-scale sensor data, exploiting the
  time-frequency signature of moving targets to lift detection mAP by **200%** and
  downstream **F1 from 0.5 to 0.8**.
- Built a PyTorch signal-processing library over SAR SLC and phase-history products;
  accelerated ray tracing **400×** and image formation **1000×** with a dependency-free
  C/C++ library, and shifted research teams toward modern foundation models.

### Postdoctoral Research Associate — The University of Texas at Dallas
*Jan 2023 – Sep 2023*

- Authored a hybrid deep-learning / signal-processing framework for SAR multiband
  fusion achieving ~3× super-resolution on a hardware prototype; patented the
  domain-informed architecture.
- Developed complex-valued neural networks for frequency estimation, improving
  probability of resolution by up to **15%** in low-SNR regimes.

### Wireless Sensing Technologist (Research) — Microsoft
*Sep 2022 – Jan 2023*

- Built ML infrastructure for an ego-centric RF simulation platform (**10×** downstream
  model efficiency); pioneered multimodal sensor fusion (RF, mmWave, ToF, LiDAR) and
  filed patents on novel sensing architectures.

### Earlier research internships
*2019 – 2021*

- **Apple** — display-calibration AI/ML (2021); **IMEC** — computational imaging &
  deep learning (2020); **Texas Instruments (TxACE)** — mmWave radar perception (2019).

## Skills

- **Languages / tooling:** Python, C/C++, MATLAB, PyTorch, TensorFlow, `complextorch`,
  geospatial stack (rasterio, geopandas, shapely, xarray, GDAL, STAC), Modal.
- **MLOps / systems:** Kubernetes, Argo, AWS/EKS, Docker, distributed training, CI/CD,
  observability and on-call.
- **Domains:** SAR/InSAR, polarimetry, complex-valued / phase-aware deep learning,
  foundation-model adaptation, change detection, mmWave radar perception.
